verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a Pay by Bank / Payments API v3 product for initiating payments from users' bank accounts. It states its geography as the UK and EU and gives a providers endpoint for checking supported banks in each European country, and it adds mandate-based payments that execute without re-authorisation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live payment initiation, an explicit per-country list of live markets in the docs themselves.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly

citations.quote: The Payments API v3 allows you to make and accept payments and payouts in the UK and EU.
Accept Pay by Bank payments. Covers the API, authentication, webhooks and testing.
Query the providers endpoint to see which banks are supported in each European country and segment.
Once you create a payment on an authorised mandate, it executes immediately without requiring further user authorisation.
